Subtracting 227 days from 1767-03-04.  
1767 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1767-03-04 back 2 days → 1767-03-02.  
Back 31 days of February (1767-02 has 28 days) → 1767-02-02 after 30 more days? Let's compute systematically:  

227 days = 7 months + some days. Better: count backward:  
March 4 → Feb 4 is 28 days back (since Feb has 28 days in 1767) → 28 days subtracted, 199 left.  
Feb 4 → Jan 4 is 31 days back → 199-31=168 left.  
Jan 4 → Dec 4, 1766 is 31 days back → 168-31=137 left.  
Dec 4 → Nov 4 is 30 days back → 137-30=107 left.  
Nov 4 → Oct 4 is 31 days back → 107-31=76 left.  
Oct 4 → Sep 4 is 30 days back → 76-30=46 left.  
Sep 4 → Aug 4 is 31 days back → 46-31=15 left.  
Aug 4 → July 20 is 15 days back (July has 31 days: from Aug 4 back 1 day = Aug 3, back 15 days = July 20).  

So final date is 1766-07-20.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1766-07-20
